title: The editor may crash when reloading the scene while a node is selected
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible when built using `use_asan=yes`, 

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta (5d9722e83) - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 25.22 GiB memory

### Issue description

The editor will crash when the following conditions are met:
- The editor is built with `use_asan=yes`;
- A node is selected in the currently edited scene;
- The selected node is visible in the Workspace;
- After the scene is modified outside, upon entering the editor, "Reload from disk" is selected in the pop-up dialog.

After the crash, if the `.godot` directory is not deleted, the crash can be reproduced even when building the editor with different parameters.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Build the editor with `use_asan=yes`;
2. Import and edit `mrp.zip`;
3. Open the scene and select a node;
4. Modify the scene timestamp externally (e.g., using `touch`);
5. Return to the editor and select "Reload from disk" in the pop-up dialog. Crash.
6. Repeating steps 2 through 5 using v4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47] still results in a crash.
7. After deleting `.godot`, repeating steps 2-5 using v4.6.beta2.official [551ce8d47] **does not** cause a crash.
